Coverage_Description: Group medical reimbursement plan with worldwide (or worldwide excluding North America) cover for hospitalization, surgery, post-hospitalisation, outpatient and emergency care; annual limit HK$16,000,000 and lifetime limit HK$40,000,000
customer requirement: Minimum 3 full-time employees; same-class employees must join the same basic plan (and same optional benefits if selected)
price structure: Annual renewable group premium with yearly review/adjustment; Insurance Authority levy applies (general business levy rate up to 0.1%, capped at HK$5,000)
additional informations: US coinsurance applies to non-emergency US treatment (50% member share for US citizens or stays over 182 days); conversion option available after 2 consecutive years for medically underwritten insured aged 65 or below
